grandMA Object Trees

The complete software-defined object tree of grandMA2 onPC 3.9 and grandMA3 onPC 2.5, crawled from a running console. Click a row to open it, search by class or name, copy an address.

Properties. Selecting a row lists the properties of that object class (the names you read and set), their type, whether they are read-only, and for option lists every value they accept. grandMA2 gives property names and the kind of value seen; its option lists are not exposed by the console, so they are not shown. Current values are not published. Search also matches property names.
What is left out. Anything that describes a particular station is not here: network, session and station entries, connected USB and display hardware, user and profile instances, show settings and variables. Show data (groups, sequences, macros, patch and the like) is reduced to its class structure, one example per item class, marked items omitted. In a pool, the last number in an address is the pool item number. A slots n badge is the pool's capacity.
Select a row to see its properties and the values each can take.
